description_en: Detaches a data source from a policy. After the data source is detached, the policy no longer protects it. Use this operation with caution
description_zh: 将数据源与策略解绑，解绑后，策略将无法保护该数据源，请谨慎操作
kebab_example: aliyun hbr delete-policy-binding --policy-id po-000000000000000hgp --data-source-ids i-2ze000000000000quf --source-type UDM_ECS --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletePolicyBinding

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the data sources to detach from the policy
parameters.help_zh: 需要解除与策略绑定的数据源ID列表
parameters.name: data_source_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- **UDM\_ECS**: indicates an ECS instance backup
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：
* **UDM_ECS**：表示ECS整机备份
parameters.name: source_type
